verses.geez:
ወበጽሑ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ተዓይኒሆሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ዘ[ፂን] ፡ በቀዳሚ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ ወነበረ ፡ ሕዝብ
                  ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቃዴስ ፡ ወሞተት ፡ በህየ ፡ ማርያም ፡ ወተቀብረት ፡ ህየ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Sin, in the first month, and the people abode in Cades; and Mariam died there, and was buried there.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Sin, in the first month, and the people abode in Cades; and Mariam died there, and was buried there.
translations.kjv: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
translations.ron: În luna întâi a ajuns toată obştea fiilor lui Israel în pustiul Sin şi s-a oprit poporul în Cadeş. Şi a murit Mariam şi a fost îngropată acolo.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦλθον οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ, πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ, εἰς τὴν ἔρημον Σὶν, ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πρώτῳ, καὶ κατέμεινεν ὁ λαὸς ἐν Κάδης· καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν ἐκεῖ Μαριὰμ, καὶ ἐτάφη ἐκεῖ.

verses.geez: ወኦልቦቱ ፡ ማየ ፡ ለትዕይንት ፡ ወተጋብኡ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ አሮን ።
verses.translation: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and Aaron.

translations.lxx: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and Aaron.
translations.kjv: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
translations.ron: Acolo însă nu era apă pentru obşte şi s-au adunat ei împotriva lui Moise şi a lui Aaron,
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὕδωρ τῇ συναγωγῇ· καὶ ἠθροίσθησαν ἐπὶ Μωυσῆν καὶ Ἀαρών.

verses.geez: ወፀአልዎ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ኀየሰነ ፡ ንሙት ፡ በሞተ ፡ አኀዊነ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And the people reviled Moses, saying, Would we had died in the destruction of our brethren before the Lord!

translations.lxx: And the people reviled Moses, saying, Would we had died in the destruction of our brethren before the Lord!
translations.kjv: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
translations.ron: Şi blestema poporul pe Moise şi zicea: "O, de am fi murit şi noi când au murit fraţii noştri înaintea Domnului!
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλοιδορεῖτο ὁ λαὸς πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγοντες, ὄφελον ἀπεθάνομεν ἐν τῇ ἀπωλείᾳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν ἔναντι Κυρίου.

verses.geez: ወለምንት ፡ አውፃእክሙ ፡ ትዕይንቶ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ከመ ፡ ትቅትሉነ ፡ ወለእንስሳነሂ ።
verses.translation: And wherefore have ye brought up the congregation of the Lord into this wilderness, to kill us and our cattle?

translations.lxx: And wherefore have ye brought up the congregation of the Lord into this wilderness, to kill us and our cattle?
translations.kjv: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
translations.ron: La ce aţi adus voi obştea Domnului în pustiul acesta, ca să ne omorâţi şi pe noi şi dobitoacele noastre?
translations.grk: Καὶ ἱνατί ἀνηγάγετε τὴν συναγωγὴν Κυρίου εἰς τὴν ἔρημον ταύτην ἀποκτεῖναι ἡμᾶς, καὶ τα κτήνη ἡμῶν;

verses.geez:
ወለምንት ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ዘአውፃእክሙነ ፡ እምነ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታምጽኡነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ መካን ፡ እኩይ ፡ መካን ፡
                  ዘኢይዘ[ራ]እ ፡ ወዘአልቦ ፡ በለሰ ፡ ወአልቦቱ ፡ አዕጻደ ፡ ወይን ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ሮማን ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ማየ ፡ ለሰትይ ።
verses.translation: And wherefore is this? Ye have brought us up out of Egypt, that we should come into this evil place; a place where there is no sowing, neither figs, nor vines, nor pomegranates, neither is there water to drink.

translations.lxx: And wherefore is this? Ye have brought us up out of Egypt, that we should come into this evil place; a place where there is no sowing, neither figs, nor vines, nor pomegranates, neither is there water to drink.
translations.kjv: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
translations.ron: Şi la ce ne-aţi scos din Egipt, ca să ne aduceţi în acest loc rău, unde nu se poate semăna şi nu sunt nici smochini, nici vite, nici rodii şi nici măcar apă de băut?"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἱνατί τοῦτο; ἀνηγάγετε ἡμᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου, παραγενέσθαι εἰς τὸν τόπον τὸν πονηρὸν τοῦτον· τόπος οὗ οὐ σπείρεται, οὐδὲ συκαῖ, οὐδὲ ἄμπελοι, οὔτε ῥοαὶ, οὔτε ὕδωρ ἐστὶ πιεῖν.

verses.geez:
ወመጽኡ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጾሙ ፡ ለትዕይንት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወወድቁ ፡ በገጾሙ
                  ፡ ወአስተርአየ ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሎሙ ።
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron went from before the assembly to the door of the tabernacle of witness, and they fell upon their faces; and the glory of the Lord appeared to them.

translations.lxx: And Moses and Aaron went from before the assembly to the door of the tabernacle of witness, and they fell upon their faces; and the glory of the Lord appeared to them.
translations.kjv: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.
translations.ron: Atunci s-au dus Moise şi Aaron din faţa poporului la uşa cortului adunării şi au căzut cu fetele la pământ şi s-a arătat slava Domnului peste ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦλθε Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἀαρὼν ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς συναγωγῆς ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ ἔπεσον ἐπὶ πρόσωπον· καὶ ὤφθη ἡ δόξα Κυρίου πρὸς αὐτοὺς.

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ንሥኣ ፡ ለእንታክቲ ፡ በትር ፡ ወአስተጋብኡ ፡ ትዕይንተ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ እኁከ ፡ ወበልዋ ፡ ለኰኵሕ ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ
                  ፡ ወትሁብ ፡ ማያ ፡ ወታወፅኡ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ማየ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ ወታሰትዩ ፡ ትዕይንተ ፡ ወእንስሳሆሙኒ ።
verses.translation: Take thy rod, and call the assembly, thou and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye to the rock before them, and it shall give forth its waters; and ye shall bring forth for them water out of the rock, and give drink to the congregation and their cattle.

translations.lxx: Take thy rod, and call the assembly, thou and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye to the rock before them, and it shall give forth its waters; and ye shall bring forth for them water out of the rock, and give drink to the congregation and their cattle.
translations.kjv: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
translations.ron: "Ia toiagul şi adună obştea, tu şi Aaron, fratele tău, şi grăiţi stâncii înaintea lor şi ea vă va da apă; şi le veţi scoate apă din stâncă şi veţi adăpa obştea şi dobitoacele ei".
translations.grk: λάβε τὴν ῥάβδον σου, καὶ ἐκκλησίασον τὴν συναγωγὴν σὺ καὶ Ἀαρὼν ὁ ἀδελφός σου, καὶ λαλήσατε πρὸς τὴν πέτραν ἐναντίον αὐτῶν, καὶ δώσει τὰ ὕδατα αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐξοίσετε αὐτοῖς ὕδωρ ἐκ τῆς πέτρας, καὶ ποτιεῖτε τὴν συναγωγὴν, καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ በትር ፡ እንተ ፡ እምቅድሜሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Moses took his rod which was before the Lord, as the Lord commanded.

translations.lxx: And Moses took his rod which was before the Lord, as the Lord commanded.
translations.kjv: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
translations.ron: A luat deci Moise toiagul din faţa Domnului, cum poruncise Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔλαβε Μωυσῆς τὴν ῥάβδον τὴν ἀπέναντι Κυρίου, καθὰ συνέταξε Κύριος.

verses.geez:
ወአስተጋብእዎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ ለትዕይንት ፡ ቅድሜሃ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ስምዑኒ ፡ ከሓድያን ፡ ቦኑ
                  ፡ እምነ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ ናወፅእ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ማየ ።
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron assembled the congregation before the rock, and said to them, Hear me, ye disobedient ones; must we bring you water out of this rock?

translations.lxx: And Moses and Aaron assembled the congregation before the rock, and said to them, Hear me, ye disobedient ones; must we bring you water out of this rock?
translations.kjv: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
translations.ron: Şi au adunat Moise şi Aaron obştea la stâncă şi a zis către obşte: "Ascultaţi, îndărătnicilor, au doară din stânca aceasta vă vom scoate apă?"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξεκκλησίασε Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἀαρὼν τὴν συναγωγὴν ἀπέναντι τῆς πέτρας, καὶ εἶπε πρὸς αὐτοὺς, ἀκούσατέ μου οἱ ἀπειθεῖς· μὴ ἐκ τῆς πέτρας ταύτης ἐξάξομεν ὑμῖν ὕδωρ;

verses.geez:
ወአልዐለ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ወዘበጣ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ በእንታክቲ ፡ በትር ፡ ካዕበ ፡ ወወፅአ ፡ ማይ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡
                  ወሰትዩ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ ወእንሳሆሙኒ ።
verses.translation: And Moses lifted up his hand and struck the rock with his rod twice; and much water came forth, and the congregation drank, and their cattle.

translations.lxx: And Moses lifted up his hand and struck the rock with his rod twice; and much water came forth, and the congregation drank, and their cattle.
translations.kjv: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
translations.ron: Apoi şi-a ridicat Moise mâna şi a lovit în stâncă cu toiagul său de două ori şi î ieşit apă multă şi băut obştea şi dobitoacele ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπάρας Μωυσῆς τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ, ἐπάταξε τὴν πέτραν τῇ ῥάβδῳ δίς· καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὕδωρ πολὺ, καὶ ἔπιεν ἡ συναγωγὴ, καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወለአሮን ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢአመንክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትቀድሱኒ ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡
                  እስራኤል ፡ በበይነ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ኢታበውእዎሙ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ለዛቲ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ አነ ፡ ወሀብክዎሙ
                  ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, Because ye have not believed me to sanctify me before the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, Because ye have not believed me to sanctify me before the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
translations.ron: Atunci a zis Domnul către Moise şi Aaron: "Pentru că nu M-aţi crezut, ca să arătaţi sfinţenia Mea înaintea ochilor fiilor lui Israel, de aceea nu veţi duce voi adunarea aceasta în pământul pe care am să i-l dau".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ἀαρὼν, ὅτι οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε ἁγιάσαι με ἐναντίον τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ εἰσάξετε ὑμεῖς τὴν συναγωγὴν ταύτην εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν δέδωκα αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: ወዝንተ ፡ ማይ ፡ ዘቅስት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተዋቀሱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: This is the water of Strife, because the children of Israel spoke insolently before the Lord, and he was sanctified in them.

translations.lxx: This is the water of Strife, because the children of Israel spoke insolently before the Lord, and he was sanctified in them.
translations.kjv: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
translations.ron: Aceasta este apa Meriba, căci aici fiii lui Israel s-au certat înaintea Domnului, iar El S-a sfinţit între ei.
translations.grk: Τοῦτο τὸ ὕδωρ Ἀντιλογίας, ὅτι ἐλοιδορήθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ ἡγιάσθη ἐν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez:
ወፈነወ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ መላእክተ ፡ እምነ ፡ ቃዴስ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኤዶም ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ከመዝአ ፡ ይቤአ ፡ እኁከአ
                  ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለሊከ ፡ ታአምር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሕማመነ ፡ ዘረከብነ ።
verses.translation: And Moses sent messengers from Cades to the king of Edom, saying, Thus says thy brother Israel; Thou knowest all the distress that has come upon us.

translations.lxx: And Moses sent messengers from Cades to the king of Edom, saying, Thus says thy brother Israel; Thou knowest all the distress that has come upon us.
translations.kjv: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:
translations.ron: Din Cadeş a trimis Moise soli la regele Edomului, ca să-i spună: "Aşa zice fratele tău Israel: Tu ştii toate greutăţile ce am îndurat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέστειλε Μωυσῆς ἀγγέλους ἐκ Κάδης πρὸς βασιλέα Ἐδὼμ, λέγων, τάδε λέγει ὁ ἀδελφός σου Ἰσραήλ· σὺ ἐπίστῃ πάντα τὸν μόχθον τὸν εὑρόντα ἡμᾶς.

verses.geez:
ወወረዱ ፡ አበዊነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወነበሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ወሣቀዩነ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወለአበዊነሂ
                  ።
verses.translation: And how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we sojourned in Egypt many days, and the Egyptians afflicted us and our fathers.

translations.lxx: And how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we sojourned in Egypt many days, and the Egyptians afflicted us and our fathers.
translations.kjv: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
translations.ron: Părinţii noştri s-au pogorât în Egipt şi noi am pribegit în Egipt vreme multă; dar Egiptenii ne-au făcut rău nouă şi părinţilor noştri.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατέβησαν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν εἰς Αἴγυπτον, καὶ παρῳκήσαμεν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ἡμέρας πλείους, καὶ ἐκάκωσαν ἡμᾶς οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι καὶ τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν.

verses.geez:
ወጸራኅነ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወሰምዐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቃለነ ፡ ወፈነወ ፡ መልአኮ ፡ ወአውጽአነ ፡ እምነ ፡ ግብጽ
                  ፡ ወይእዜኒ ፡ ሀለውነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገር ፡ ቃደስ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ብሔርከ ።
verses.translation: And we cried to the Lord, and the Lord heard our voice, and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt; and now we are in the city of Cades, at the extremity of thy coasts.

translations.lxx: And we cried to the Lord, and the Lord heard our voice, and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt; and now we are in the city of Cades, at the extremity of thy coasts.
translations.kjv: And when we cried unto the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
translations.ron: De aceea am strigat către Domnul şi a auzit Domnul glasul nostru şi a trimis îngerul Său de ne-a scos din Egipt; şi acum suntem în Cadeş, oraşul cel mai apropiat de hotarul tău.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνεβοήσαμεν πρὸς Κύριον, καὶ εἰσήκουσε Κύριος τῆς φωνῆς ἡμῶν, καὶ ἀποστείλας ἄγγελον, ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου· καὶ νῦν ἐσμὲν ἐν Κάδης πόλει, ἐκ μέρους τῶν ὁρίων σου.

verses.geez:
ወአኅልፈነ ፡ እንተ ፡ ምድርከ ፡ ወኢንኅልፍ ፡ እንተ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ገራኅት ፡ ወኢላዕለ ፡ አዕጻደ ፡ ወይን ፡ ወኢንሰቲ ፡
                  እምዐዘቃት ፡ ማየ ፤ ፍኖተ ፡ መጽያኅተ ፡ ነሐውር ፡ ወኢንትገሐሥ ፡ ኢለየማንአ ፡ ወኢለፀጋምአ ፡ እስከአ ፡ ነኀልፍአ ፡
                  እምደወልከአ ።
verses.translation: We will pass through thy land: we will not go through the fields, nor through the vineyards, nor will we drink water out of thy cistern: we will go by the king's highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left, until we have passed thy borders.

translations.lxx: We will pass through thy land: we will not go through the fields, nor through the vineyards, nor will we drink water out of thy cistern: we will go by the king's highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
translations.kjv: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king’s high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
translations.ron: Îngăduieşte-ne să trecem prin ţara ta, că nu ne vom abate pe la ogoare şi pe la vii, nici apă nu vom bea din fântânile tale; ci vom trece pe drumul împărătesc, neabătându-ne nici la dreapta, nici la stânga, până vom ieşi din hotarele tale".
translations.grk: Παρελευσόμεθα διὰ τῆς γῆς σου· οὐ διελευσόμεθα διʼ ἀγρῶν, οὐδὲ διʼ ἀμπελώνων, οὐδὲ πιόμεθα ὕδωρ ἐκ λάκκου σου· ὁδῷ βασιλικῇ πορευσόμεθα· οὐκ ἐκκλινοῦμεν δεξιὰ οὐδὲ εὐώνυμα, ἕως ἂν παρέλθωμεν τὰ ὅριά σου.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ ኤዶም ፡ ኢተኀልፍአ ፡ እንተአ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ወእመአኮሰአ ፡ ንትቃተልአ ፡ እወጽእ ፡ እትቀበልከአ ።
verses.translation: And Edom said to him, Thou shalt not pass through me, and if otherwise, I will go forth to meet thee in war.

translations.lxx: And Edom said to him, Thou shalt not pass through me, and if otherwise, I will go forth to meet thee in war.
translations.kjv: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
translations.ron: Edom însă i-a răspuns: "Să nu treci pe la mine, iar de nu vei asculta voi ieşi cu război înaintea ta".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἐδὼμ, Οὐ διελεύσῃ διʼ ἐμοῦ· εἰ δὲ μὴ, ἐν πολέμῳ ἐξελεύσομαι εἰς συνάντησίν σοι.

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እንተአ ፡ መንገለአ ፡ አድባር ፡ ንኅልፍ ፡ ወለእመኒ ፡ ሰተይነ ፡ እምነ ፡ ማይከ ፡
                  ንሕነ ፡ ወእንስሳነ ፡ ሤጦ ፡ ንሁበከ ፡ ወዝንቱሰ ፡ ኢኮነ ፡ ወኢምንተኒ ፡ እንተ ፡ መንገለ ፡ ደብርአ ፡ ንኅልፍአ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel say to him, We will pass by the mountain; and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, I will pay thee: but it is no matter of importance, we will go by the mountain.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel say to him, We will pass by the mountain; and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, I will pay thee: but it is no matter of importance, we will go by the mountain.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing anything else, go through on my feet.
translations.ron: Zisu-i-au fiii lui Israel: "Vom merge pe drumul cel mare şi de vom bea din apa ta, noi sau dobitoacele noastre, îţi vom plăti; vom trece numai cu piciorul, ceea ce e un lucru de nimic".
translations.grk: Καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ, παρὰ τὸ ὄρος παρελευσόμεθα· ἐὰν δὲ τοῦ ὕδατός σου πίωμεν ἐγώ τε καὶ τὰ κτήνη μου, δώσω τιμήν σοι· ἀλλὰ τὸ πρᾶγμα οὐδέν ἐστι· παρὰ τὸ ὄρος παρελευσόμεθα.

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ ኢትኅልፍአ ፡ እንተአ ፡ ላዕሌየአ ፤ ወወፅአ ፡ ኤዶም ፡ ተቀበሎ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ክቡድ ፡ ወበእድ ፡ ጽንዕት
                  ።
verses.translation: And he said, Thou shalt not pass through me; and Edom went forth to meet him with a great host, and a mighty hand.

translations.lxx: And he said, Thou shalt not pass through me; and Edom went forth to meet him with a great host, and a mighty hand.
translations.kjv: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
translations.ron: Iar acela i-a răspuns: "Să nu treci pe la mine!" Şi a ieşit Edom înaintea lui cu popor mult şi cu mână puternică.
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν, οὐ διελεύσῃ διʼ ἐμοῦ· καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ἐδὼμ εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ ἐν ὄχλῳ βαρεῖ, καὶ ἐν χειρὶ ἰσχυρᾷ.

verses.geez: ወኢፈቀደ ፡ ኤዶም ፡ የሀቦ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ምኅላፈ ፡ እንተ ፡ ደወሉ ፡ ወተግሕሰ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እምኔሁ ።
verses.translation: So Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through his borders, and Israel turned away from him.

translations.lxx: So Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through his borders, and Israel turned away from him.
translations.kjv: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
translations.ron: Deci nu s-a învoit Edom să dea voie lui Israel să treacă prin hotarele lui şi Israel s-a depărtat de la el.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν Ἐδὼμ δοῦναι τῷ Ἰσραὴλ παρελθεῖν διὰ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐξέκλινεν Ἰσραὴλ ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወግዕዙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ቃዴስ ፡ ወኀደሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ሆር ።
verses.translation: And they departed from Cades; and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Or.

translations.lxx: And they departed from Cades; and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Or.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
translations.ron: După aceea au pornit fiii lui Israel din Cadeş şi au venit toată obştea la muntele Hor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπῇραν ἐκ Καδης· καὶ παρεγένοντο οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ εἰς Ὢρ τὸ ὄρος.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወለአሮን ፡ በደብረ ፡ ሆር ፡ በመንገለ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ምድሩ ፡ ለኤዶም ፡ እንዘ ፡
                  ይብል ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron in mount Or, on the borders of the land of Edom, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron in mount Or, on the borders of the land of Edom, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
translations.ron: Iar la muntele Hor, care e lângă hotarele ţării lui Edom, a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi cu Aaron şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ἀαρὼν ἐν Ὢρ τῷ ὄρει ἐπὶ τῶν ὁρίων τῆς γῆς Ἐδὼμ, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ለይትወሰክ ፡ አሮን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሕዝቡ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢትበውኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ አነ ፡ ወሀብክዎሙ ፡
                  ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እስመ ፡ አምዓዕክሙኒ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ማየ ፡ ቅስት ።
verses.translation: Let Aaron be added to his people; for ye shall certainly not go into the land which I have given the children of Israel, because ye provoked me at the water of strife.

translations.lxx: Let Aaron be added to his people; for ye shall certainly not go into the land which I have given the children of Israel, because ye provoked me at the water of strife.
translations.kjv: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
translations.ron: "Aaron va fi adăugat la poporul său, că el nu va intra în pământul pe care îl voi da fiilor lui Israel, pentru că nu v-aţi supus poruncii Mele la apa Meriba.
translations.grk: προστεθήτω Ἀαρὼν πρὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ, ὅτι οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν δέδωκα τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ, διότι παρωξύνατέ με ἐπὶ τοῦ ὕδατος τῆς λοιδορίας.

verses.geez: ንሥኦ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለእልዓዛር ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ወአዕርጎሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ሆር ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ትዕይንት ።
verses.translation: Take Aaron, and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to the mount Or before all the congregation;

translations.lxx: Take Aaron, and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to the mount Or before all the congregation;
translations.kjv: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
translations.ron: Să iei dar pe fratele tău Aaron şi pe Eleazar, fiul lui, şi să-i sui pe muntele Hor înaintea întregii obşti;
translations.grk: Λάβε τὸν Ἀαρὼν, καὶ Ἐλεάζαρ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀναβίβασον αὐτοὺς εἰς Ὢρ τὸ ὄρος, ἔναντι πάσης τῆς συναγωγῆς,

verses.geez:
ወንሣእ ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ እምላዕሌሁ ፡ ወአልብሶ ፡ ለአልዓዛር ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ወይትወሰክ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወይሙት ፡ በህየ
                  ።
verses.translation: and take Aaron's apparel from off him, and put it on Eleazar his son: and let Aaron die there and be added to his people.

translations.lxx: and take Aaron's apparel from off him, and put it on Eleazar his son: and let Aaron die there and be added to his people.
translations.kjv: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.
translations.ron: Să dezbraci acolo de pe Aaron hainele lui şi să îmbraci cu ele pe Eleazar, fiul lui, şi Aaron să se ducă şi să moară acolo".
translations.grk: καὶ ἔκδυσον Ἀαρὼν τὴν στολὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔνδυσον Ἐλεάζαρ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ· καὶ Ἀαρὼν προστεθεὶς ἀποθανέτω ἐκεῖ.

verses.geez: ወገብረ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአዕረጎሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ሆር ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ትዕይንት ።
verses.translation: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him, and took him up to mount Or, before all the congregation.

translations.lxx: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him, and took him up to mount Or, before all the congregation.
translations.kjv: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
translations.ron: Şi a făcut Moise aşa cum îi poruncise Domnul: i-a suit pe muntele Hor înaintea ochilor întregii obşti.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησε Μωυσῆς καθὰ συνέταξε Κύριος αὐτῷ, καὶ ἀνεβίβασεν αὐτὸν εἰς Ὢρ τὸ ὄρος, ἐναντίον πάσης τῆς συναγωγῆς,

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ እምላዕሌሁ ፡ ወአልበሶ ፡ ለእልዓዛር ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ወሞተ ፡ አሮን ፡ በውስተ ፡ ርእሰ ፡
                  ደብር ፡ ወወረዱ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወእልዓዛር ፡ እምነ ፡ ደብር ።
verses.translation: And he took Aaron's garments off him, and put them on Eleazar his son, and Aaron died on the top of the mountain; and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

translations.lxx: And he took Aaron's garments off him, and put them on Eleazar his son, and Aaron died on the top of the mountain; and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
translations.kjv: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
translations.ron: Acolo a dezbrăcat Moise de pe Aaron hainele lui şi a îmbrăcat cu ele pe Eleazar, fiul lui. Şi a murit Aaron pe vârful muntelui, iar Moise şi Eleazar s-au pogorât din munte.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐξέδυσε τὸν Ἀαρὼν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐνέδυσεν αὐτὰ Ἐλεάζαρ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ἀαρὼν ἐπὶ τῆς κορυφῆς τοῦ ὄρους· καὶ κατέβη Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἐλεάζαρ ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους.

verses.geez:
ወርእዩ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ ከመ ፡ ሐለፈ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወበከይዎ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ፴መዋዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እስራኤል
                  ።
verses.translation: And all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead: and they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

translations.lxx: And all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead: and they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
translations.kjv: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
translations.ron: Văzând toată obştea că a murit Aaron, l-a plâns toată casa lui Israel treizeci de zile.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶδε πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ ὅτι ἀπελύθη Ἀαρὼν, καὶ ἔκλαυσαν τὸν Ἀαρὼν τριάκοντα ἡμέρας πᾶς οἶκος Ἰσραήλ.
